outcome: Maternal toxicity (signs of systemic toxicity, histopathological changes, organ weight, water and feed intake)
Fetal development (skeletal development delay, bone malformations/skeletal abnormalities)
cohort: Pregnant rats receiving oral treatment from the 6th to the 15th day of gestation.
finding: While rosemary essential oil and 1,8-cineole did not affect maternal reproductive rates or cause systemic toxicity in pregnant rats, they induced fetal skeletal development delay and a higher proportion of skeletal abnormalities.
gest_age: Exposure occurred from gestational day 6 to 15
